impacts.overview: Rain · Oct 21–22 · Moderate confidence in regional rain / high-Sierra snow
impacts.geography: Fresno portions of the regional San Joaquin Valley / Coastal Range outlook; not a site-specific forecast.
impacts.impact: Rain and cooler conditions. The regional outlook lists rain Wednesday and Thursday.
impacts.timing: Early Wednesday morning, Oct 21, through Thursday, Oct 22, 2026 · local PDT. Exact onset and end hours are not stated.
impacts.confidence: Moderate for the regional rain / high-Sierra snow forecast (key points). High confidence refers to the broader pattern change, not flooding.
impacts.probability: No county-wide rainfall probability is stated in this page's key points.
impacts.planning: Planning / Operations: review drainage and culvert inspection coverage, road crew availability, and access to owner-approved staging sites before the forecast window.
impacts.limitation: Rain does not establish river flooding or safe access. Check current gauges, reservoir operators and official closures. Kern County wind and heavy-rain details on this page are excluded.

impacts.overview: Snow / hazardous mountain travel · Oct 21–22 · Medium confidence
impacts.geography: High-elevation Fresno portions of the Sierra Nevada outlook. It does not apply to valley roads or every county facility.
impacts.impact: Snow may make travel hazardous on open mountain passes.
impacts.timing: Wednesday, Oct 21, and Thursday, Oct 22, 2026 · local PDT. Exact hours are not stated.
impacts.confidence: Medium, as labeled in the public summary's Sierra Nevada snow details.
impacts.probability: 40% chance of at least 4 in of snow above 8,000 ft in the public summary. This is regional, not a probability at every Fresno site.
impacts.planning: Operations: confirm high-elevation road status, winter equipment and crew readiness, and alternate communications or access with responsible road and facility owners before assigning resources.
impacts.limitation: The source's Tioga Pass example is outside Fresno County. Partner-slide snowfall probabilities use a different regional description; do not blend them with this public-summary value.
